items.title: PostgreSQL + pgvector production cluster
items.contract: TLS verify-full, non-superuser application role, FORCE RLS, migrations Job, PITR and tested restore.
items.failure_policy: No SQLite or unrestricted retry in controlled mode.
items.acceptance: Live CI and staging evidence with zero RLS leakage and measured restore.

items.title: Enterprise OIDC + entitlement lifecycle + PAM
items.contract: Pinned issuer/audience/algorithms, short sessions, server-side entitlements, offboarding, break-glass approval and audit.
items.acceptance: Rotation, revocation, offboarding and break-glass drills pass.

items.title: S3 Object Lock + KMS/HSM
items.contract: Content-addressed writes, checksum verification, governance retention, key rotation and recovery ceremony.
items.failure_policy: No downgrade to mutable storage or application-held root key.
items.acceptance: Retention, tamper, rotation and restore tests pass.

items.title: GitLab protected delivery + OCI registry
items.contract: Protected branches/tags, isolated runners, rootless build, digest promotion, SBOM, signing and SLSA provenance.
items.failure_policy: Unsigned or unscanned artifact cannot deploy.
items.acceptance: Policy evidence exported; production deploy verifies provenance and signatures.

items.title: OpenTelemetry + metrics/log backend + SIEM
items.contract: Bounded-cardinality telemetry, durable backend, security correlation, retention and alert ownership.
items.failure_policy: Telemetry outage cannot alter answer semantics; security-critical audit loss fails readiness.
items.acceptance: End-to-end serving-path probe, alert drill and SIEM correlation pass.

items.title: Controlled embedding/model gateway
items.contract: Corpus-policy egress decision before transmission, fixed model/version/dimension, minimized text, rate limits and drift rollback.
items.failure_policy: Semantic weight remains zero when provider/profile is unavailable or unvalidated.
items.acceptance: No forbidden corpus egress; model migration and drift tests pass.

items.title: Independent audit anchor + backup vault
items.contract: Separate trust domain, monotonic authenticated checkpoints, durable outbox, immutable encrypted backups and independent retention.
items.failure_policy: Anchor disagreement or recovery ambiguity fails readiness and blocks promotion.
items.acceptance: Truncation, replay, key rotation, anchor outage and disaster recovery drills pass.
